<section class="body bleed">
<div class="wrap">
<div class="cols">

<div class="main">

<div class="prose">
<span class="kicker">About</span>
<p>I am an Associate Research Scientist in the <a href="https://ysph.yale.edu/public-health-research-and-practice/department-research/biostatistics/">Department of Biostatistics</a> at the <a href="https://ysph.yale.edu/">Yale School of Public Health</a>, working with <a href="https://ysph.yale.edu/profile/bhramar-mukherjee/">Dr. Bhramar Mukherjee</a>. My research develops semiparametric and causal methods for large-scale electronic health records (EHR), where the times a patient is seen, and the moments a biomarker is recorded, are themselves informative about health.</p>
<p>I received my Ph.D. in Biostatistics from <a href="https://sph.uth.edu/divisions/biostatistics/">UTHealth Houston</a> in 2025, advised by <a href="https://faculty.mdanderson.org/profiles/ruitao_lin.html">Dr. Ruitao Lin</a>, with a thesis on Bayesian adaptive designs for early-phase oncology trials. My work spans two connected programs: modeling informative visit and observation processes in EHR, and adaptive dose-finding for modern cancer therapeutics.</p>
</div>

<span class="kicker" style="margin-top:2.2rem;">Research focus</span>
<div class="themes">

<div class="theme">
<h3>Informative presence &amp; observation in EHR</h3>
<p>Semiparametric joint models that correct the biases arising when clinical contact and measurement depend on a patient's underlying condition.</p>
</div>

<div class="theme">
<h3>Adaptive dose-finding design</h3>
<p>Seamless phase I–II designs that use biological mediators and survival endpoints to optimize dose for targeted therapies and immunotherapies.</p>
</div>

<div class="theme">
<h3>Causal inference from observational data</h3>
<p>Estimands and estimators for treatment effects under irregular follow-up, including dynamic regimes in real-world cohorts.</p>
</div>

<div class="theme">
<h3>Variable screening &amp; treatment regimes</h3>
<p>Model-free screening for high-dimensional survival data that stays valid without assuming an outcome model or a form for the regime.</p>
</div>

</div>
</div>
